environment.description: Actix-web log aggregation service deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'logging' on a cluster running Istio 1.19 with permissive mTLS mode. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service with no network policies. All pods in the mesh can reach this service. No Istio AuthorizationPolicy resources are defined for the 'logging' namespace. The service runs as root with no seccomp profile.
